Implementation
STRATA_PREFILL_ROUTE_UNION=1 is strict opt-in (0/other/unset are OFF). New header RouteUnion is pure bounded CPU receipt, with no GPU/runtime dependency. Each layer stores eight uint64 bitmap words and five uint64 counters/extents (token rows, chunks, distinct active-expert visits, unique union, source blob bytes). Eligibility uses geometry alone: 1..64 layers, n_expert=512, K=10, positive rows/chunks. No hardware model string is tested. A diagnostic decline does not introduce an inference gate or alter ordinary eligibility.

Integration and lifetime proof
Prefill::run reports a bounded single decline for ordinary flow or empty prompt when explicitly enabled. run_layer_major uses an admission receipt for failures before route collection, then allocates one tiny RouteUnion only when requested. Its owner is declared before Restore, so Restore destroys/drains before the census owner. Impl borrows its pointer only during this request. observe runs after the existing ids_host.from_device submission AND existing checked stream_sync(m.cs), immediately following pt.fold, before the existing host grouping loop. It consumes ids_host.data()/size(), current layer, c0, T and expert_layout().blob_bytes(layer). It adds no kernel, copy, readback, event, clock, wait, per-job output, route selection, math, cache policy or handoff atomic.
Restore calls existing layer_major::retire: cancel stager, drain compute/copy, finish stager, then restore owner pointers. Only its successful-drain restore callback clears Impl::route_union and emits the receipt. A failed fatal drain never emits a successful record. union_success remains false until every existing per-layer run_impl succeeds. Early return/exception/cancellation emits partial or invalid after drain. Receipt.finish requires exact row and chunk coverage per layer and checked per-layer/aggregate byte arithmetic before publishing complete. No token routes or sets survive the request.

Bounds and semantics
Layer storage arithmetic: 64*(8+5)*8=6656 bytes. Request scalar fields and padding yield 6696 bytes on usual LP64 ABI (arithmetic prediction, not an executed sizeof result); static_assert enforces sizeof(RouteUnion)<8192 on the actual compiler. observe has one 64-byte temporary bitmap; combined explicit receipt+bitmap data remains below 8 KiB. OFF adds a getenv/strict flag branch, null borrowed-pointer branch and small guard/pointer bookkeeping, no census allocation/clock/sync. Enabled emission is at most 64 layer rows plus one summary; pre-admission/ordinary decline emits only one summary.
active_visits is the sum of per-chunk distinct selected experts; union_experts is U_l across the entire request. It is not the existing resident aggregate or token route count. rows denotes consumed token rows, topk=10 defines route positions. Offset continuity, previous-layer full coverage, no future-layer start, IDs 0..511, copied ID extent, constant blob extent, counter overflow and final coverage are checked. union_logical_bytes=U_l*blob_bytes(layer), full_logical_bytes=512*blob_bytes(layer). These are hypothetical logical extents, not observed bus/DMA bytes and do not change today's all-512 upload. Invalid/partial summary totals remain zero; every row carries status so incomplete measurements cannot be interpreted as successful unions.

Source-only fixtures
Added CPU route_union_test target with strata_warnings (no suppression). Fixture has distinct ten-ID chunks overlapping at 0 and 511: active visits=20, union=18; checks endpoint bits, repeated-request reset, cancellation/error with all routes observed, negative/out-of-range experts/layers, out-of-order layer, row gap, repeated chunk, inconsistent blob extent, partial coverage, incomplete route rows, expected-route overflow, visit-counter overflow, per-layer and aggregate byte overflow, n_expert !=512, too many/no layers, wrong K and empty flow. Tests do not mirror only union bit-setting; they check request coverage/status and distinguishing visits from union.
JA docs were written before EN docs, with the same scope. New C++ files have SPDX identifiers. Existing files were not reformatted.

UNEXECUTED — Main owns all builds/tests/GPU/cleanup, serialized.
No build, test, lint, AST, GPU/model, profiler, process/service query, cleanup, commit or push occurred. Source reads, git worktree add and source/report edits only. One initial source-writing command used unavailable 'python' and returned 127 before executing; repeated using python3 to write files. Neither invocation executes tests.
Main CPU commands (external output path, adapt task-owned folder):
  c++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I<worktree>/include <worktree>/tests/core/route_union_test.cpp -o <Main-owned-output>/route_union_test
  <Main-owned-output>/route_union_test
Or use Main's existing host-only CMake configuration with STRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON, then:
  cmake --build <Main-owned-build> --target route_union_test
  ctest --test-dir <Main-owned-build> -R '^route_union_test$' --output-on-failure
Main should build engine under the established exact qualified4K toolchain/flags, verify OFF output/math unchanged, then enable only STRATA_PREFILL_ROUTE_UNION=1 on the established fresh prompt qualification. Check one complete request gives exact per-layer expected rows/chunks, visits>=union and sum of logical extents; run a second fresh request to check reset; check cancellation/error never complete. Keep GPU workload and trace retention ownership serialized. This implementation has no measured speedup or numerical qualification.
